found_targets.title: setbidtobuy allows token purchase even when sale is no longer listed
found_targets.evidence: The SetBidToBuy function is called, but there is no check in the execute.rs to ensure the token's sell.islisted is true. The setbidtobuy method (not shown in the provided snippet) likely allows a bid to be placed without verifying the sale is active, leading to a state inconsistency where a bid can be processed even if the sale was unlisted.
